canonical_name: Viviani's theorem for an equilateral triangle (exact source formulation open)
category: 几何学 / 欧几里得几何
literal_source_claim_zh: 等边三角形内点到三边距离之和为常数
literal_source_claim_en: For an interior point of an equilateral triangle, the sum of the distances to the three sides is constant.
source_attribution: Vincenzo Viviani, 1659 (catalog metadata only; no work, edition, or passage is cited)
candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: For a source-selected nondegenerate equilateral Euclidean triangle and a point in its source-selected interior, the sum of the three nonnegative perpendicular distances to its side lines equals the triangle's altitude.
statement_blocker: The located 1659 primary theorem is for arbitrary regular polygons and points inside or on the perimeter, while the catalog selects an equilateral triangle and an interior point. Neither source fixes a Lean ambient dimension, finite side segment versus supporting line, signed versus unsigned distance, ordered binders, or whether the catalog root should be point-independence or the derived common-altitude equality. The working Latin translation, critical-edition and correction audit, exact specialization, and source-to-Lean mapping have no independent approval. Choosing those clauses at intake would silently complete or broaden the sparse catalog wording.
target_decision: retain the catalog's narrower equilateral-triangle strict-interior constant-distance-sum family; require independent approval of the preserved primary passage, translation, corrections, exact specialization, altitude alternate form, and source-to-Lean mapping before freezing one target

canonical_formal_target.candidate_expression: {V P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace Real V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle Real P) -> t.Equilateral -> (p : P) -> p in t.interior -> (sum i : Fin 3, abs (t.signedInfDist i p)) = t.height 0

domain_and_universes: Open: an accepted source must fix a two-dimensional Euclidean affine space or an allowed higher-dimensional ambient space with the triangle's affine-span restriction, the point and vector universes, real scalar and inner-product structures, an ordered affinely independent triangle, and the interior and distance domains.
conclusion: Prospective family only: the three source-defined perpendicular distances from the admitted point to the three source-defined sides have a point-independent sum; whether this is stated as equality to a selected/common altitude or existence of a constant remains open.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; statement work must resolve repeated or collinear vertices, zero side length, strict-interior emptiness, points on sides or vertices, points outside, side-line versus side-segment distance, signed-distance orientation, vertex reindexing, and higher-dimensional ambient components.

closed-interior extension including points on sides and vertices

the converse constant-sum characterization of equilateral triangles substituted for the forward theorem
